svg.text: McCzarny recently focused heavily on the
chromium-daily-digest project, introducing
support for the "OpenCode" LLM provider and
later updating it to use the OpenCode Go API.
He enhanced summary generation by displaying
the model used and improving OpenCode API
context handling with a new
OPENCODE_CONTEXT_LIMIT. He also implemented a
fallback mechanism for daily summary generation
and added a GitHub Actions workflow to publish
website pages on every push to main. Further
CI/CD improvements included refactoring
workflow names and adding a mapWithConcurrency
utility for better API request management. For
chromium-daily-digest, he also refined the
OpenCode service's retry logic and dismissal of
the "Go to next unread" toast. In the dcvis
repository, he refactored the application for
improved data visualization, shortening data
center names and adjusting map zoom. He also
expanded dcvis by introducing a new data center
location, "Piaseczno", and updating the
application to dynamically load layers and
presets.
